verdict.rationale: The evidence does not include the vendor's published memory type, maximum capacity, channel count, memory speed, or bandwidth for this CPU, so a developer cannot size memory-bound workloads from it. What it does show is adjacent: ECC support (board-dependent), EXPO overclocking, a DDR5 mention on the separate Ryzen Master utility page, and 208MB of on-chip cache, which is not system memory.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)
